name: P0 - man on the Fifth Avenue sidewalk in front of the middle of the Met steps
method: Foot of the perpendicular from the midpoint of the two Met plaza fountains (OSM ways 552699591, 552699597) onto the OSM Fifth Avenue west-side sidewalk centreline (way 332132158, "Central Park Outer Loop", footway=sidewalk). ~3.5 m from the curb, ~21 m from the Met facade, opposite E 82nd St.
frame: x = east metres, y = north metres. Transverse Mercator, k0 = 1, WGS84 ellipsoid, central meridian/latitude through P0. Scale error < 1e-5 within 15 km, positional distortion vs. true ground distance < 0.15 m within 30 km.
grid_note: Manhattan street grid: Fifth Avenue runs at this bearing (clockwise from true north); streets are perpendicular.
